Name: Lord_lord_2_23
Quirks: speaks with the blunt Northern manner, less polished than his older brothers
references his father and the Karstark name with the pride of someone still growing into it
is more uncertain beneath the Northern bravado than he lets on
CharacterDescription:
The youngest son of Lord Rickard Karstark of Karhold, a young man in his teens who has grown up in the shadow of his older brothers Harrion and Torrhen and their father's fierce loyalty to House Stark. The Karstarks are descended from a younger son of Winterfell generations back — they share Stark blood and Stark stubbornness and the same grim Northern cast.

He is young enough that the war beginning in the south feels partly like adventure and partly like terror. He has been raised on stories of the Karstarks riding to war beside the Starks, of the honor of the North, of what it means to be a man of Karhold. He has not yet been tested against those stories and does not know if he will measure up. He suspects he will find out soon.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Youngest son of Lord Rickard Karstark.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Karhold or with the Northern forces marching south, two days before Ned Stark's execution. The North has called its banners and the Karstarks ride with Robb Stark.
